title: Monday Quick Tip
subtitle: Who starts
hook: How do you decide who starts on game day?
intro: Every kid wants to be on the field first.
You have five spots and nine players.
statement: Starting matters more to kids than adults think.
q1: Do you rotate starters every game —
q2: or start the players who earned it in practice?
q3: How does it feel to never start?
t1: No single answer fits every team. But kids stay invested
t2: when they understand how starters are picked.
cta: Coaches — how do you pick starters?
ctaLines: A rotation chart. Practice effort. A mix of both.
ctaPrompt: Share your lineup habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
How do you decide who starts on game day?
Every kid wants to be on the field first. You have five spots and nine players.
Starting matters more to kids than adults think.
Rotate starters or let them earn it. There is no perfect answer.
How do you pick starters? Share your habit in the comments.
